_notes: Alberta has kept UTC-6 all year since 2026 (Lake Louise's feed stamps -06:00 on 2026-11-15; skilouise.com: 'year-round Alberta Time'), so local time is a fixed offset.

window: 'collect --scheduled' only fetches on these local dates, within an hour after one of the slots (Banff time). The workflow starts each run 5 minutes after its slot: 5:30, 6:00 and 6:30am, then hourly 7am-5pm (11:35-23:05 UTC).

zones: where Open-Meteo is sampled. elev_m is passed to the model, which corrects temperature to that height. 'report' is the resort's own snow-report section for the same zone; 'station' is the resort weather station's name.
Sunshine's mid-mountain report is at the Village; its base zone is the gondola base, where the Banff Ave ski-out ends. Lake Louise's upper station is Paradise-Top.
